title: Секрет лучших продуктов  (The Secret of the Best Products)

segments.t: It's prep time in the kitchen at Claude Monet, with knives going on every board. Barinov walks past, inspects the chopping, and then tells Max where good cooking really starts: at the market. It's in Russian first, and you can let the odd word go.
А где мы возьмём свежее мясо?
Нет, я сам выбираю всё на рынке.
Настоящий шеф не доверяет чужим людям.
Ты останешься на кухне чистить картошку.
Slowly now. Barinov is giving orders, which means plenty of useful commands.
'So, cooks, chop all the vegetables.' To kick things off, you will hear the chef mention
'Chef, we are already chopping onions.' Max quickly points out that they are
, already, chopping exactly what was asked.
'Chop faster, guests will come soon.' Notice how the head chef warns that
, meaning soon, the hungry guests will arrive.
А где мы возьмём свежее мясо?
'And where will we get fresh meat?' It is very important to find completely
, or fresh, meat for this busy restaurant.
'First a cook selects the best products.' The experienced master explains they always need
, meaning the absolute best, ingredients to cook with.
'Do we buy meat in a shop?' Our young cook naively wonders about the
, which is a regular shop, rather than a market.
Нет, я сам выбираю всё на рынке.
'No, I choose everything myself at the market.' Instead, the older man insists on the
, the open market, for picking out the best items.
'Do you personally inspect every piece?' A good eager student asks if he
, personally, checks every piece of food they buy.
Настоящий шеф не доверяет чужим людям.
'A real chef does not trust strangers.' According to the professional in charge, a
, or real, cook relies on nobody else.
'May I go with you?' Hoping to learn more, the helper asks to
, which means to go along for the ride.
Ты останешься на кухне чистить картошку.
'You will stay in the kitchen peeling potatoes.' Unfortunately for him, he just has to
, or peel, potatoes all day long.
'I dreamed of selecting the best products.' The trainee reveals that he has always
, dreamed, of doing the more exciting prep work.
'First learn to cut without mistakes!' The final piece of advice is about avoiding
, mistakes, while doing the basic chopping tasks. Back to the scene as it happened.
А где мы возьмём свежее мясо?
Нет, я сам выбираю всё на рынке.
Настоящий шеф не доверяет чужим людям.
Ты останешься на кухне чистить картошку.
You've heard "snachala", first, "bystree", faster, and "bez oshibok", without mistakes, which is a fair description of a trainee's day. See you next time.
